levelledPara.title: Purpose
levelledPara.para: The Office Collaboration Platform is a proof of concept for creating, uploading and co-editing Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents in the browser. Editing is delegated to a self-hosted ONLYOFFICE Document Server; the platform owns document metadata, versions, permissions and file storage.

levelledPara.title: Components
levelledPara.para: The system has these runtime components, defined in docker-compose.yml:

entry.para: Serves the built React SPA (frontend/dist) at / and proxies /api/ to Document Core.
REST API for documents, editor configuration, and ONLYOFFICE content/callback endpoints.
Renders the editor in the browser and returns saved files to Document Core.
Supabase project, or local postgres:15 container
AWS S3 (not provisioned by the app)
Stores the file bytes of each document version.

levelledPara.para: An interactive architecture diagram is at docs/diagrams/system-architecture.html.

levelledPara.title: Open a document
levelledPara.para: The SPA requests GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/editor-config. Document Core returns a JWT-signed ONLYOFFICE configuration. The browser loads the ONLYOFFICE editor, which fetches the file from GET /api/v1/onlyoffice/content.

levelledPara.title: Save a document
levelledPara.para: ONLYOFFICE posts to POST /api/v1/onlyoffice/callback. On status 2 (ready for saving) or 3, Document Core downloads the file from the supplied URL, writes it to S3 and records a new row in document_versions. Other statuses are ignored.

levelledPara.title: Limitations of this build
levelledPara.para: There is no end-user authentication. Every request acts as a single fixed user (LocalUser, id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001). Presence, AI and parsing features are not built.

note.notePara: The root README.md still describes Supabase Auth login. The code does not implement it; this data module describes the code as built.
